purpose: The dark sibling of Complications Light: the same layout on a fixed dark dial. It is the only face that declares slots in the registry, and it hardcodes what it draws in them rather than reading them.

night.recipe: Grounds on --face-plate with its four tiles in --face-ghost, the reverse of Complications Light's figure/ground, so the two faces stay distinct in both palettes. Ink is --face-ink, the DEMO rows and cloud shapes --face-ink-muted.

options.intent: One colour for every sub-dial accent; the sub-dials are siblings, not a hierarchy.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not let the admin assign complications to its four slots as if they rendered
antiPatterns.why: the slots are declared but the face draws hardcoded content; D2 says wire, never fake
